findings.title: Upsampling check uses the outer dataset and original request query
findings.body: _get_event_stats receives scoped_dataset and query, but the new call to is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects passes the endpoint's captured dataset and the original request, not the dataset/query being executed. In the dashboard split path _get_event_stats is called with discover and errors_only_query or transactions_only_query. A transaction-only split can therefore still be classified as an error query when the original request contained event.type:error, and its count() is rewritten to sum(sample_weight) even though transactions have no sample_weight, causing zero or undercounted results. Conversely, an error-only split is not upsampled when the original request did not contain event.type:error. Pass scoped_dataset and query.

findings.title: Substring match treats negated or mixed event.type:error queries as error-only
findings.body: _is_error_focused_query only checks whether the lowercased query contains the literal substring event.type:error. Queries such as !event.type:error, NOT event.type:error, event.type:transaction OR event.type:error, or free text containing that substring are not error-only queries, but the helper returns True. For the discover dataset this rewrites count() to sum(sample_weight) for queries that can include transactions or other events without sample_weight, so the response undercounts or returns zero. This needs a query-aware check rather than a substring search.

findings.title: Top-events ordering is still based on raw count
findings.body: Only the y-axis/timeseries columns are rewritten when upsampling is enabled. The orderby passed to run_top_events_timeseries_query here and to top_events_timeseries later is still self.get_orderby(request), typically -count(). The top N groups are therefore selected using raw event counts while the returned series use sum(sample_weight), so the selected groups and displayed charts are inconsistent and the top groups may be wrong. Transform the orderby aggregate and count-containing equations the same way, or avoid upsampling for top-events queries.

findings.title: Accidental gitlink/submodule added
findings.body: The PR adds a path named sentry-repo containing only a subproject commit and no .gitmodules entry. This has nothing to do with error upsampling and will make checkouts contain an unresolved gitlink; CI or packaging that expects a normal tree can fail or leave an empty directory. Remove the accidental submodule entry.

findings.title: Public eligibility/caching function is not tested
findings.body: The new test module imports and exercises only the private helpers. is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects, which is the public entry point combining allowlist eligibility, caching, dataset selection, and request-query interpretation, is never called. This leaves cache hit/miss behavior and the interaction between the actual executed query and the request query untested, allowing the dashboard-split and negated-query bugs above to slip through. Add tests for the public function, cache invalidation, and split-query behavior.
